Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa Auditora Externa você atuará com serviços de auditoria contábil de forma consistente, reunindo equipes multidisciplinares para abordar os problemas mais complexos de nossos clientes em diversos segmentos. Usando a metodologia comprovada de auditoria global e as mais recentes ferramentas e tecnologias de auditoria de alta qualidade,assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de trabalho produtivos com os funcionários do cliente e avaliar sua satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos supervisores a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação a equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho.

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Habilidades de gestão de projetos;
  • Dedicação ao trabalho em equipe e à liderança .

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Conhecimento de US e BR GAAP, IFRS, CVM e SEC;

Overview

The project is funded by NIH, and it is a collaborative effort between Howard University Cancer Center and The Johns Hopkins University Cancer Center. The candidate will conduct research in the field of biopharmaceutical applications of nanotechnology.

Supervisory Authority

None

Nature And Scope

Research specifically in bioconjugate chemistry involving tethering of monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and peptides to polymers with detailed physicochemical and biological characterizations for use in the design of polymeric nanoparticles for the delivery of bioactive agents. Drug-loaded nanoparticles fabrication with detailed physicochemical and biological characterization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monthly reports and semi-annual reports. Publications and grantsmanship.
  • The candidate will report to Professor Emmanuel O. Akala.
  • Weekly meetings to keep Professor abreast on the developments on the project.
  • Challenges in meeting the laboratory deadlines presented to NIH should be discussed at weekly meetings so that the problems can be nipped in the bud.

Core Competencies

  • Bioconjugate chemistry (Polymer chemistry, organic chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, etc.).
  • Biological and physicochemical characterization techniques (NMR, FTIR, HPLC (small molecule and protein analysis), LC/MS, Flow cytometry, scanning electron microscopy, transmission electron microscopy, zeta potential determination, Atomic Absorption Spectrometry, and MALDI-TOF Mass Spectrometry).

Minimum Requirements

Ph.D. in Polymer chemistry or Chemistry or Biomedical Engineering.

description:
As an Independent Power Producer,Voltalia operates in over 20 countries, developing, building, and maintainingrenewable energy projects and services across five key technologies: solar,wind, hydro, biomass, and storage. Backed by the AFM Group, a globallyrecognized, family-owned investment group, we benefit from long-term stabilityand a shared commitment to sustainable growth.

By the end of 2024, our operational and under-construction capacity reached 3.3 gigawatts—a 14% increase since 2023. With 1,500 employees worldwide, we thrive in a fast-moving environment driven by adaptability, innovation, and collaboration.

In our company, your work directly contributes to a more sustainable world. Whether you're driving projects forward, optimizing operations, or leading strategic initiatives, you're contributing to our mission to improve the global environment and foster local development.

At Voltalia, we welcome individuals from all backgrounds, whatever your race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, age, disability, sexual orientation, and experience. In our company, diversity drives innovation and contributes to a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Ready to make an impact? Bring your energy—let’s power a sustainable future together!

YOUR MISSIONS

The Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer is responsible for the administration, optimization, and continuous improvement of security technologies, while also serving as a Tier 3 escalation point for complex security incidents. This role bridges advanced incident response with hands-on engineering of cybersecurity tools, ensuring seamless integration, effective threat detection, and rapid response capabilities. Acting as an extension of external Tier 1 and Tier 2 security operations, the engineer plays a critical role in enhancing the organization’s overall security posture through proactive monitoring, tool fine-tuning, and strategic incident handling.
Security Tools Administration

  • Administer and optimize security tools, including SIEM, EDR/XDR (Microsoft Defender), firewalls, vulnerability management, email and identity security solutions.
  • Ensure seamless integration of security tools with IT and cloud environments for continuous monitoring and threat detection.
  • Maintain security policies, configurations, and automation rules to improve operational efficiency and reduce false positives.
  • Manage log sources, data ingestion pipelines, and correlation rules within SIEM to enhance security visibility.

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Act as a Tier 3 escalation point for security incidents requiring advanced investigation and resolution.
  • Conduct deep-dive forensic analysis and threat-hunting activities to detect and mitigate sophisticated threats.
  • Support the SOC team and external Tier 1 & Tier 2 analysts by providing expertise on complex security incidents.
  • Enhance and refine incident response playbooks, ensuring effective collaboration across all security layers.
  • Align incident response efforts with cybersecurity frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, and ISO 27001.

Threat Intelligence & Vulnerability Management

  • Analyze threat intelligence feeds and proactively adjust defenses based on evolving attack techniques.
  • Coordinate vulnerability assessments, collaborate with IT teams, and track remediation efforts to mitigate risks.
  • Perform proactive threat-hunting activities to identify potential security gaps before they are exploited.
  • Ensure compliance with patch management policies and security best practices.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in security tools administration, incident response, or security operations.
  • Experience in listed companies, large-scale enterprises, or multi-geographical organizations is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Security solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, firewalls, and security automation tools.
  • Proficiency in threat intelligence, forensic analysis, and malware analysis.
  • Strong understanding of network security, log analysis, and cloud security.
  • Experience with vulnerability management solutions.
  • CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst, or equivalent.
  • Availability to travel internationally

KEY SKILLS

  • Problem-Solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with IT, cloud, and development teams, as well as external security partners.
  • Attention to Detail.
  • Resilient.
  • Willingness to stay current with evolving cybersecurity threats and technologies.
  • Ability to manage multiple security incidents and projects simultaneously.

description:
Job Description

The Managing Principal Engineer (MPE) for Ship and Statutory Department is a strategic position for the ABS Rio de Janeiro Engineering Department. As ABS continues to expand its services and deliverables, this leadership role strengthens client engagement, enhances technical oversight, and streamlines departmental operations.

Responsibilities

  • Functions under the direction and oversight of a more senior Department Engineering Manager, directs and monitors project work within a technical area of a larger engineering department, and holds full responsibility for outcomes in that area.
  • Leads in their area of specialization and assigns work according to priority.
  • Acts as a technical resource and mentor to principal, senior and entry to mid-level engineers in the area of responsibility.
  • Maintains day-to-day activities, including the quality, content, consistency and continuity of all technical work performed in an assigned technical unit or area.

What You Will Do

  • Responsible for the technical verification of tasks related to ship/statutory disciplines and training new engineers in these areas.
  • Assists in the development of short- and long-range business plans and related annual operating and capital expense budgets.
  • Maintains active awareness of business and management developments affecting present and potential customers.
  • Maintains awareness of product and service capabilities of the business. Identifies improvement and developmental needs, takes action to capitalize on prospective market opportunities and makes recommendations for technology or technical tools and manpower skills necessary to implement new and improved products and services.
  • Ensures that assigned engineering positions are adequately staffed with qualified and competent personnel capable of carrying out assigned technical projects in accordance with established policies, procedures and technical standards.
  • Ensures that all ABS Quality System requirements are fulfilled with regard to project work within a technical unit or area.
  • Monitors the delivery and quality of technical services to customer satisfaction.
  • Prepares annual performance appraisals. Evaluates and communicates individual performance issues with staff under direct supervision, and recommends compensation adjustments and advancements to senior management.
  • Identifies training needs and determines appropriate training programs for developing subordinate and engineering staff members.
  • Plans and monitors ABS mandatory, required and other training needs of subordinate staff members.
  • May serve as account manager on technical projects for designated customers and actively promotes the services of ABS to clients.
  • May serve on technical or industry committees and may represent the company as a spokesperson at industry conferences or meetings.

Education and Experience

  • B.S. degree in Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or Marine Engineering; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Proficiency in English commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services; ability to communicate effectively with both laymen and experts.
  • Technical background on designing and/or reviewing different types of ships.

For those with Hull backgrounds

  • B.S. degree in Civil, Structural Engineering, Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • Exposure to the Finite Element Method (coursework or supervised research).

For those with Machinery backgrounds

  • B.S. degree in Marine, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering or related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Graduate from university with a minimum of 15 years of related industry experience.
  • B.S. degree in Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or Marine Engineering; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Experience in the design and review of ship structures for offshore support vessels, tugs, pushers, and barges for rivers, intracoastal, and oceangoing services; familiarity with large merchant vessels is an asset.
  • Proficiency in conducting intact and damage stability analyses for ships and offshore structures, including freeboard calculations, verification of loading manuals, and related documentation.

Knowledge of safety arrangements requirements for ships and offshore structures based on applicable International Conventions and Regulations for a broad range of ships and floating units, including Brazilian-flagged vessels, including but not limited to Stability, Load Line, Tonnage, SOLAS, MARPOL, IBWMC, MLC, NORMAMs, etc.

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent reports directly to a Senior Managing Principal Engineer or higher. Direct reports include engineering or technical staff and office support staff of the assigned technical unit or area.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency guides our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other safety, quality, and environmental services. We support the global energy transition at sea, remote and autonomous marine systems, and cutting-edge technical solutions.

Overview

The Associate Creative Director plays a key role in the university’s integrated marketing strategy, reporting to the Assistant Vice Chancellor of Marketing and leading a small internal team and external creative partners. Remote/Work Details

Please note: The role requires an 8 am - 5 pm PST schedule. Potential travel to bi-annual commencements and meeting in person with vendors 1-4 times per year. Remote work is available from the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Minnesota, Nevada, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin.

Internal applicants should access the Jobs Hub app on the Workday Dashboard homepage to apply for the position.

Supervision and Responsibilities

TYPE OF SUPERVISION:

  • General Direction — indicates that the incumbent receives guidance in terms of broad goals and overall objectives and is responsible for establishing the methods to attain them. Generally, the incumbent is in charge of an area of work; and typically formulates policy for this area but does not necessarily have final authority for approving policy

POSITION DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Creative & Brand Direction:

  • Lead and approve all creative and branded marketing assets for digital, print, collateral, and campaigns

  • Mentor and assign work to the Senior Graphic Designer and Marketing Copywriter, support their development and the team’s high-performance culture
  • Manage freelance creatives and agency partners to ensure all output aligns with university brand and strategy

Campaign Support & Channel Adaptation:

  • Serve as a key creative leader and cross-channel expert in campaign planning and execution with the media team, agency, and creative partners
  • Ensure all creative and copy is tailored to the strengths of each platform (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, programmatic TV, PMax)

Creative Testing:

  • Champion and utilize campaign analytics and creative performance tools (such as iSpot) to track effectiveness and drive ongoing A/B and multivariate testing, maximizing creative results per channel and audience

Vendor & Collateral Program Coordination:

  • Serve as primary point of contact for the university's sales collateral/event material vendor, overseeing program effectiveness and proper material use
  • Coordinate closely with the Marketing Coordinator to plan inventory and lead annual reviews—making informed recommendations to retain, revise, or retire collateral based on usage and business needs
  • Perform other duties, as assigned

Position Specifications and Requirements

Education, Experience, Certification and/or Licenses:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Marketing, Advertising, Fine Arts, or a related field
  • At least 6 years of professional creative/marketing experience, including 2+ years in a supervisory or team lead role
  • Hands-on experience developing and directing integrated, multichannel marketing campaigns, especially digital and social media
  • Proven ability managing agency and freelance relationships, as well as leading creative testing and campaign performance optimization

Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and strong understanding of digital channel requirements (web, social, video, etc.)
  • Demonstrated skill in creative leadership, team development, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Knowledge and ability to use creative analytics/testing (e.g., A/B testing, platform analytics tools like iSpot), and ability to adapt creative based on data and channel insights
  • Up-to-date knowledge of current and emerging trends in marketing, design, media formats, and creative technology

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Electronic Devices and Software: Laptop computer running Mac OS, suitable for high-end graphic design and video editing; Design & Creative Software including Adobe Creative Suite and additional tools such as Figma for rapid prototyping and digital asset creation; Project Management & Collaboration Platforms; Digital Asset & Content Management systems and file-sharing platforms such as SharePoint for organizing and distributing creative files and collateral; Creative Testing & Analytics Tools.

Contact with Students: Occasional

Contact with Faculty and/or Staff: Frequent

Contact with Community and Vendors: Frequent

The individual in this role is also expected to travel to bi-annual commencements and meet in person with vendors and/or agencies 1–4 times per year. Applicants for this position are subject to a background check and a criminal history review.

Overview

Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry role at Nexer Telescope. Start ASAP.

Job Description

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. You will be supported by a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden, and by our Swedish delivery management team that handles relocation logistics for our consultants. We fix everything for our employees – visa, work permits, tickets, housing, and related arrangements. Our clients are primarily in software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development.

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Training Site Infrastructure Manager reports to the FWWC27 Head of Infrastructure and Technical Services and FIFA Training Sites Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Tournament Infrastructure team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA\'s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

This position plays a pivotal role in the planning, development, and delivery of infrastructure at FIFA Women\'s World Cup 2027 training sites across Brazil. Working alongside the FIFA Training Site Manager and in coordination with Team Services, Technical Services, Pitch Management, Venue Design, Dressing & Signage, Media Operations, Partnerships and external stakeholders (Training Site Authorities and Football Clubs), the role is responsible for ensuring all training sites are operationally ready and compliant with FIFA’s requirements and standards.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in architectural and interior design, technical project management, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale international event delivery. As demonstrated through global events such as FIFA World Cups and Olympic Games. They will manage the implementation of training site upgrades, including renovations, overlays, and delivery of essential infrastructure, with a focus on strategic planning, design integration, and resource optimization.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the design and infrastructure delivery strategy for all FWWC2027 training sites, incorporating best practices in venue planning, design management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinate the implementation of renovations and upgrades, overseeing construction quality, progress, and alignment with FIFA’s requirements and standards.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of overlay and technical service delivery, including scope definition, scheduling, procurement, installation, and handover.
  • Engage with Training Site Authorities, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Implement project controls for budgeting, reporting, and risk mitigation.
  • Ensure sustainability, cultural alignment, and aesthetic quality across all training site environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Pitch Management, Cleaning & Waste, Venue Design, and Dressing & Signage to ensure cohesive delivery.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 10+ years of experience in architectural design, project management, and delivery of international sporting event infrastructure.
  • Proven track record in managing venue delivery and readiness, overlay operations, or major venue infrastructure for events like FIFA World Cup or Olympics.
  • Strong technical expertise in space planning, stakeholder communication, and procurement processes.
  • Bachelor\'s or Master’s Degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women\'s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\'s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounting Manager to join our growing offshore team. The ideal candidate will oversee the full accounting cycle for multiple high-growth startup clients, manage month-end close and reconciliations, ensure GAAP-compliant financial reporting, and lead day-to-day client accounting operations including AP, AR, payroll, and revenue recognition. They will also guide and review the work of client teams, maintain consistent accounting policies, and partner closely with startup executives to provide financial insights and recommendations.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary accounting lead and controller for 2–3 large, high-growth startup clients.
  • Manage and review monthly close processes, including balance sheet and P&L reconciliations (prepaid expenses, fixed assets, accrued liabilities, deferred revenue, etc.).
  • Oversee core accounting functions such as accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, inventory, and revenue recognition.
  • Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting, delivering GAAP-compliant financial statements and management reports.
  • Partner directly with startup executive teams (CEOs, CFOs, VPs of Finance) to provide insights, recommendations, and proactive financial support.
  • Maintain consistent accounting policies and procedures across clients, documenting best practices to ensure scalability and efficiency.
  • Manage the day-to-day workflow of your dedicated client teams, reviewing their work and ensuring quality deliverables.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally within Furey to continuously improve client processes and enhance service delivery.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA or equivalent designation preferred). MBA would be a plus
  • 15+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally with exposure to high-growth startups, venture-backed companies, or outsourced accounting (at least 3 years of experience with an accounting firm is required)
  • 5+ years experience in a manager position
  • Fluency in English (written and verbal) required
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and technical accounting concepts.
  • Proven experience leading month-end close and producing accurate financial statements.
  • Hands-on expertise with accounting systems (QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar) and strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and project management skills with the ability to handle multiple clients simultaneously.
  • Strong client relationship skills and ability to communicate effectively with startup executives.
  • Experience in Inventory and Cost Accounting

Nice to Haves

  • Work experience at one of the big four US accounting firms (KPMG, PricewaterhouseCoopers, Deloitte, Ernst & Young)
  • Ability to create or improve processes. We’re a fast paced start up and don’t always have lengthy process documentation available.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Unlimited Paid Days Off + 14 paid federal holidays per calendar year
  • Time zone & Working hours: Monday to Thursday 9 am - 6 pm, and Friday 9 am - 1 pm EST.

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume in English!

About Atacadão

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.
Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.
Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.
O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

O Grupo Carrefour Brasil promove e incentiva a inclusão e a diversidade! Por isso, estimulamos a candidatura de mulheres, profissionais negros (as), LGBTI+ e de pessoas com deficiência.

SOBRE A NIP DO BRASIL

 Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos executivos de redes de distribuição de gás natural, contribuindo com soluções técnicas seguras e sustentáveis desde o anteprojeto até a entrega final. Desejáveis:

 A NIP do Brasil valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão em todas as suas formas.

Requisitos necessários

  • Experiência comprovada em transição de serviços de TI, gestão de serviços ou área relacionada.
  • Sólida experiência em infraestrutura de TI, aplicações e frameworks de gestão de serviços (ex.: ITIL).

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation ou equivalente.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas, adaptabilidade e gestão de mudanças, consciência de custos, elaboração de business cases e avaliação de benefícios, abordagem de simplificação (pensamento enxuto / lean thinking).

  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe.
  • Fortes habilidades de influência e comunicação.
  • Inglês avançado.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Certificações ITIL avançadas (ex.: ITIL Practitioner, ITIL Intermediate).
  • Certificação Project Management Professional (PMP) ou equivalente.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem e ambientes modernos de infraestrutura de TI.

Responsabilidades e atividades do cargo

  • Supervisionar a transição dos serviços de TI para o ambiente operacional, garantindo que todos os requisitos técnicos sejam atendidos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de transição, detalhando todas as atividades necessárias para o sucesso da implantação dos serviços.
  • Garantir testes, validações e documentação robusta dos serviços de TI antes da entrada na fase operacional.
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas para resolver quaisquer problemas de transição e otimizar o desempenho dos serviços.
  • Aplicar práticas do ITIL para aprimorar os processos de transição de serviços, incluindo design de serviço, operações de serviço e melhoria contínua.
  • Utilizar metodologias ágeis para otimizar as atividades de transição, assegurando flexibilidade e capacidade de resposta às mudanças de requisitos.
  • Gerenciar o processo de transição de ponta a ponta, garantindo que todas as partes interessadas estejam informadas e engajadas.
  • Monitorar e relatar o progresso da transição, identificando riscos e implementando estratégias de mitigação quando necessário.
  • Assegurar que todas as atividades de transição sejam concluídas dentro do prazo, do escopo definido e atendendo aos padrões de qualidade.
  • Adotar frameworks de Gerenciamento de Projetos como PRINCE2 ou PMP para garantir uma gestão estruturada e eficiente das atividades de transição.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de gestão de serviços de TI para acompanhar e gerenciar atividades e documentação da transição.
  • Assegurar o uso eficaz de ferramentas de monitoramento e relatórios para avaliar o desempenho dos serviços e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Manter um entendimento abrangente da infraestrutura, ferramentas e sistemas de TI da organização.
  • Garantir conformidade com as práticas do CMDB, assegurando informações precisas e atualizadas dos ativos de serviço.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com gerentes de projeto, responsáveis pelos serviços e equipes operacionais para garantir alinhamento e prontidão para a transição.
  • Realizar revisões pós-transição para capturar lições aprendidas e implementar iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Assegurar conformidade com políticas organizacionais, padrões e requisitos regulatórios.
  • Oferecer treinamento e suporte às equipes operacionais, garantindo que estejam preparadas para gerenciar novos serviços de forma eficaz.
  • Desenvolver e manter a documentação de transição, incluindo fluxos de processos, checklists e templates para padronizar as atividades de transição.
  • Gerenciar os aspectos administrativos dos projetos de transição, incluindo acompanhamento de orçamento, alocação de recursos e gestão de cronogramas.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios regulares de status à alta gestão e às partes interessadas.
  • Manter registros precisos das atividades de transição, garantindo que toda a documentação esteja atualizada e acessível.
  • Coordenar com equipes de suporte administrativo para assegurar que todos os aspectos logísticos da transição sejam geridos de forma eficiente.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e manutenção da documentação de políticas e procedimentos relacionados às atividades de transição.

Ofertas da Vale Metais Básicos

  • Previdência Privada: garantia de um futuro tranquilo, com segurança financeira para a aposentadoria.
  • PLR - Programa de Participação nos Lucros e Resultados: participação nos lucros da empresa.
  • Assistência Médica e Hospitalar, Odontológica: cuidados de saúde para empregados e dependentes.
  • Reembolso Creche ou Auxílio Babá: apoio para conciliar o retorno ao trabalho com a chegada de um filho.
  • PASA - Planos de saúde para familiares ou para o próprio empregado.
  • Vale alimentação e Vale refeição/refeições no trabalho.
  • Apoio ao Bem-Estar, Programa de Assistência ao Empregado e Dependentes, Wellhub, Clube de Vantagens, entre outros benefícios.

Como é trabalhar na Vale Metais Básicos

Contribuímos para a formação de futuros na mineração, no planeta e em você. Oferecemos oportunidades para diversas áreas e objetivos profissionais, com um ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo que valoriza a pessoa, a sua individualidade e o seu protagonismo.

A Vale Metais Básicos acredita na troca de conhecimento e no aprendizado contínuo. Buscamos construir um legado positivo com resultados consistentes e uma mineração mais inovadora e sustentável.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in problem-solving and troubleshooting.

Why Siena

  • Globally distributed team working at the bleeding edge of CX and AI.

  • Tackle unsolved problems. We’re redefining how customer experience will look like in the next decades.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They\'re direct about feedback—both giving and receiving it—because they care more about getting things right than being polite. They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that\'s how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They\'ve built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem. Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other\'s AI workflows. At Siena, we’re not just looking for people who can do a job. We’re looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that’s you, we look forward to your application.

description:
QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a QA Engineer Specialist in our BASE area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country.
At the BASE (Business Architecture Services) Focus Area, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users and clients around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models. In this role, you will go beyond testing — you will drive quality across services and teams, mentoring engineers, shaping automation frameworks, and ensuring Wellhub continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-centric solutions.
As a Q.A. Engineer you will take end-to-end ownership of the quality of the most critical product flows and deliveries. You will be involved from the very beginning of the product lifecycle, helping with the product requirements, defining and building comprehensive test scenarios, performing in-depth exploratory testing, and automating mission-critical flows. Your work will ensure backward compatibility, performance, reliability, and overall product excellence.In addition, you will define and continuously improve the testing pipeline, driving best practices in automated testing and mentoring developers to elevate the team’s quality standards.
This role combines strong analytical QA expertise with engineering skills in a critical position that delivers meaningful impact across the organization, spanning from overall test planning to execution.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the design and implementation of test strategies (manual, automated, and exploratory) for complex distributed systems.
  • Define and evolve quality standards, frameworks, and processes across multiple services.
  • Mentor and guide software engineers, fostering a culture of ownership for quality.
  • Partner with product managers and engineering leaders to assess risks, define acceptance criteria, and shape solutions.
  • Drive test automation adoption, building scalable frameworks for APIs, backend services, and integrations.
  • Champion performance, load, and reliability testing as part of the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure quality gates and CI/CD pipelines provide fast, reliable feedback to teams.
  • Identify systemic quality issues and propose improvements in architecture, tooling, and processes.
  • Act as a quality advocate, ensuring we deliver not just working software, but trusted and delightful experiences to users.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A QA professional with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid experience in QA Engineering, with a strong background in automation (Cypress, Playwright, Rest-assured, SuperTest, Bruno, Cucumber, Postman, or similar).
  • Experienced with API testing (REST/GraphQL) and data validations in SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Familiar with cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Preferred but not required experience in performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling, Locust, K6) and their application to large-scale systems.
  • Experienced in risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and working with distributed systems.
  • Solid experience working with distributed systems using asynchronous communication (Kafka)
  • Familiar with SQL, being able to navigate complex data domains
  • Comfortable leading cross-team initiatives, influencing quality practices, and driving alignment on testing strategies.
  • Solid communication skills in English, able to articulate quality goals, trade-offs, and improvements across cultures and geographies.
  • A proactive, collaborative problem-solver who sees quality as a shared responsibility across engineering.
  • Experience with observability tools (Datadog, NewRelic, Kibana, Prometheus, Grafana Loki, or similar).
  • Preferred but not required experience with contract testing (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract, Dredd, or similar).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in QA Engineering, automation test, API testing, and distributed systems using asynchronous communicationare mandatory requirements

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

title: IT Security Engineer
description:
Overview

The Company
Capital Markets Gateway LLC (CMG) is a capital markets-focused fintech transforming global equity capital markets (ECM) through data, technology, and connectivity. As the preferred source for ECM analytics and the first network connecting the buy-side and sell-side for ECM workflows, we are committed to reshaping how capital markets operate. Founded in 2017 by a team of ECM practitioners, CMG has completed three successful fundraising rounds and is backed by a group of the world’s most prestigious financial institutions. The CMG platform is currently relied upon by nearly 150 buy-side firms representing $40 trillion in AUM and 22 global investment banks. For more information, please visit

The Role

We’re seeking an experienced and automation-driven IT Security Engineer to lead endpoint security, patching, and compliance across a globally distributed fleet of macOS, Windows, and mobile devices. In this hands-on role, you’ll architect and maintain secure-by-default baselines using modern MDM tooling (Intune, Kandji), enforce identity-first access via Entra ID, and drive proactive detection and remediation using scripting, telemetry, and Microsoft’s security stack.

Responsibilities

  • Administer and secure endpoints (macOS, Windows, mobile) via Intune, Kandji; enable zero-touch enrollment (Autopilot/ADE).
  • Serve as an escalation for endpoint issues impacting security, patching, and configuration.
  • Implement identity workflows (SSO, SCIM, RBAC, group lifecycle, access reviews) in Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Lead automated patch management for OS and third-party apps; define rings, deferrals, SLAs, and rollout/rollback playbooks.
  • Author automation in PowerShell (Windows) and Bash/Zsh (macOS) for remediation, compliance, and telemetry.
  • Integrate with the Microsoft security stack (Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft 365 Defender, Purview); tune policies, respond to alerts, and improve posture.
  • Co-define baselines with Security (CIS/NIST hardening, device compliance) and enforce via MDM.
  • Monitor device health in Endpoint Manager; investigate anomalies and drive root cause.
  • Support secure networking controls (firewall/proxy) as needed for endpoint updates and access.
  • Document policies, scripts, runbooks, and patch procedures; keep them current.

What We're Looking For

  • English level - C1 or C2
  • 5+ years managing macOS and Windows in an enterprise environment.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with at least one MDM: Intune, Jamf, Kandji.
  • Strong scripting: PowerShell (Windows) and Bash/Zsh (macOS).
  • Expert in patch management (OS + third-party), deployment rings, and compliance reporting.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security: Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft 365 Defender O365 threat policies (Anti-phish, Anti-spam, Safe Links, Safe Attachments)
  • Exchange Online security/compliance settings.
  • Familiar with Conditional Access, device compliance, and certificate/secure storage (BitLocker/FileVault).
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and written/verbal communication; ability to simplify complex problems.
  • Comfortable with CLI tooling and automation for policy deployment and monitoring.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with compliance automation (CIS Benchmarks, custom compliance policies).
  • Exposure to modern auth/device trust (Entra ID, device-based Conditional Access).
  • Familiarity with EDR platforms (e.g., Defender).
  • Experience supporting a globally distributed user/device base.
  • Python for light tooling; Git-based workflows for scripts/profiles.

Our Tech Stack

  • Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager
  • Kandji
  • Microsoft Defender for Endpoint / Microsoft 365 Defender
  • PowerShell, Bash (Python optional)
  • Azure AD / Entra ID
  • Security endpoint tools (firewall/proxy)
  • Exchange Online & M365 Security & Compliance Center

Our Values

  • We innovate with purpose
  • We focus on outcomes vs. output
  • We believe diverse and inclusive teams fuel innovation
  • We are humble yet candid
  • We do right by the customer

What We Offer

  • 2 year+ contract
  • 15 business days of vacation
  • Tech courses and conferences
  • Top-of-the-line MacBook
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Flexible working hours

CMG embraces our ongoing commitment to building a culture reflecting the people, perspectives, and passions it represents. We will accept nothing less than equity, inclusion, and belonging for all. With the only constant in life being change, we will always listen, learn, and improve for the betterment of our teams, customers, and communities. CMG is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer for our Wellbeing Access Squad within CIA (our B2B focus area) in Brazil !

This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Portugal.

Our primary objective in CIA is to establish and maintain a platform that seamlessly integrates our benefits and services into employees' lives across companies & organizations of different sizes worldwide.

As a key member of the CIA Wellbeing Access Squad, you will be focused on simplifying the employees' signup experience, making the process as seamless, secure, and stress-free as possible for our end-users. This agile team is composed of fellow developers, a product manager, and a UX designer. Together, we collaborate to improve our clients' experience using our product. You will be expected to develop the tools and the platform that power these objectives while working closely with stakeholders and the other developers. We also count on your unique view on how we evolve the platform technically and business-wise. This role is an excellent opportunity to take your expertise in back-end development to the next level.

Your Impact

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate to define the architecture of systems and integrations, bring innovation to the table, and make sure design docs are up to date.
  • Support existing systems looking to enhance functionality, increase scale, and transform in new ways to meet our product demands;
  • Ensure successful deliveries and promote the long-term technical health of our journeys.
  • Write maintainable code and tests;
  • Take part in incident resolution and troubleshooting in the production environment, as well as in writing useful and critical post-mortems.
  • Help and mentor other developers
  • Ensure high-quality code using best practices such as code review and pair programming.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Who you are

  • Proficient in one or more programming languages (Java/ Kotlin/ Golang/ Typescript/etc.). Golang will be considered a plus.
  • A believer in automation (be it tests, CI/CD, or something else entirely);
  • Communication skills to work with multidisciplinary teams located in several countries with different cultures;
  • You have advanced proficiency in English and can get your point across to technical and non-technical people in English.
  • Experience in designing and developing modern web applications;
  • Being open to new experiences, willing to learn and grow;
  • Willing to work within an agile environment meant to be continuously challenged and improved upon;
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience;

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior senior backend experience (preferably using Java, Kotlin, or Golang) is a mandatory requirement.

What we offer you

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

description:
Overview

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a motivated Configuration Engineer Junior – Controls & Automation to join our team at the TechCenter. This position offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, multinational environment, supporting automation software configuration and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.

Job Description

  • Support the configuration and versioning of automation software (TFMC proprietary systems: UCOS, InControl, SmartTool, and network components).
  • Create and maintain build, test, and deployment pipelines.
  • Generate and release technical configuration documentation using company tools.
  • Assist in executing software bench tests and support plant startup activities.
  • Participate in planning meetings using Scrum and Lean methodologies.
  • Provide support to development, QA, and operations teams.
  • The role may require field support activities such as commissioning and post-sales assistance, in compliance with local labor laws.
  • This position is open to rotations across different squads within the software team.
  • Location: Tech Center, Ilha do Fundão, RJ

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Bachelor’s degree in Control and Automation Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
  • Active CREA registration.
  • Advanced English
  • Hands-on experience in industrial automation or engineering project environments.
  • Knowledge of control systems and configuration tools.
  • Experience with code versioning practices.
  • Familiarity with industrial networks (Ethernet/IP, OPC UA/DA, PROFINET, Modbus, CANBus, etc.).
  • Understanding of Control & Automation processes: instrumentation, I/Os, sensors, actuators, and plant control logic, ensuring software configuration accurately reflects equipment functionality.
  • Practical experience working in agile teams, applying frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban, and using collaborative management tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello, etc.).

Would Be Considered a Plus

  • Programming experience in languages such as Python, MATLAB/Simulink, C, C++, C#, Java, etc.
  • Familiarity with quality and organizational methodologies (5S, ITIL).
  • Knowledge of software testing practices such as FAT, smoke testing, integration testing, and unit testing.
  • Experience with virtualized environments such as AWS, VMWare, etc.
  • Knowledge of Linux.
  • Experience with industrial network monitoring platforms such as SCADA, Matrikon (OPC), etc.

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

description:

Job Description: Essentia Health is seeking a dynamic leader to serve as Director of Physician and Provider Recruitment. In this role, you will guide strategy, lead a high-performing team, and partner with senior leaders to ensure Essentia attracts and retains top physician and advanced practice talent.

Education Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Healthcare Administration, or a related field is required.
  • A master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MHA) is preferred.
  • Professional certification in HR or talent acquisition (e.g., SHRM-SCP, SPHR, AAPPR) is a plus.

About the Role: Director, Physician and Provider Recruitment

The Director of Physician and Provider Recruitment will be a strategic and transformational leader. Reporting to the Senior Director of Physician and Professional Services, and as a member of the office of Chief Medical Officer, this leader will not only manage the full-cycle recruitment of physicians and advanced practice professionals (APPs) but will also serve as a trusted business partner to Essentia Health's senior leadership and clinical teams. The ideal candidate will leverage data and market intelligence to drive proactive workforce planning, enhance the provider experience, and ensure Essentia Health attracts and retains top-tier clinical talent.

The Opportunity: Evolving to a Talent Advisory Model

Essentia Health seeks an innovative and results-oriented Director of Physician and Provider Recruitment to lead a pivotal transformation of its talent acquisition function. This is more than a recruitment leadership role; it is an opportunity to redefine how Essentia Health finds, attracts, and integrates clinical talent. The Director will be a change agent, building a team and a strategy that proactively supports Essentia's growth, strategic goals, and commitment to patient care.

As a talent advisor , the Director will:

  • Move Beyond Transactional Recruitment: Shift the team to become a strategic partner in workforce planning. This involves anticipating future talent needs, identifying market trends, and advising clinical and operational leaders on talent strategies that align with business objectives.
  • Leverage Market Intelligence: Use data, analytics, and competitive market insights to inform decisions. The Director will develop robust dashboards to track key performance indicators (KPIs) like time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and retention rates, providing transparent and actionable insights to leadership.
  • Build a Proactive Pipeline: Transition to a highly proactive approach, building and nurturing a continuous pipeline of qualified candidates. This includes strengthening relationships with residency programs, fellowship directors, and professional associations, as well as optimizing digital and direct-sourcing strategies.
  • Enhance the Candidate and Provider Experience: Champion a seamless, professional, and personalized candidate journey from initial contact through onboarding. This includes collaborating with HR, Credentialing, and Legal teams to streamline processes and ensure a positive, welcoming experience for new providers.
  • Develop the Team's Capabilities: Mentor and coach the recruitment team to evolve, develop, and grow in their profession. This will involve equipping them with capabilities that include consulting with stakeholders, interpreting market data, and effectively managing relationships to drive better outcomes.
  • Serve as a Strategic Business Driver: Demonstrate the direct impact of the recruitment function on Essentia Health's strategic priorities, including financial performance, patient access, and clinical quality. This involves articulating the value of talent acquisition as a core business function rather than a support service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive recruitment strategy for physicians and APPs that is fully integrated with Essentia's workforce planning and growth goals.
  • Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop the provider recruitment team, fostering a culture of accountability, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Build and maintain strong, credible relationships with executive and clinical leadership, serving as a trusted advisor on all talent-related matters.
  • Operational Excellence: Oversee all aspects of the full-cycle recruitment process, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and best-in-class candidate experience.
  • Performance Analytics: Utilize metrics and dashboards to monitor recruitment effectiveness and provide regular, data-driven updates to senior leadership.
  • Brand Ambassador: Represent Essentia Health at key recruitment events and professional forums to enhance the organization's provider brand and network.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with HR, Provider Compensation, Legal, and other departments to streamline processes and ensure a coordinated approach to provider engagement and retention.

Required Experience and Knowledge

  • Progressive Leadership: A minimum of eight years of experience in healthcare, talent acquisition, or provider recruitment, with at least three to five years in a leadership role responsible for team management, resource allocation, and financial oversight.
  • Strategic Acumen: Demonstrated success in designing and executing recruitment strategies that align with broader organizational goals.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Proven ability to leverage data, analytics, and market intelligence to drive decisions and improve recruitment performance.
  • Operational Expertise: Strong knowledge of full-cycle recruitment processes, including sourcing, interviewing, contracting, and onboarding, within a complex healthcare environment.
  • Compliance and Regulation: A solid understanding of employment law, credentialing, and the unique dynamics of the provider workforce.
  • Relationship Builder: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a track record of building trusted partnerships with executive leaders, physicians, and staff.

A Home Depot Installation Services (HDIS) Design Consultant is responsible for selling the Company's exterior and interior product and services to customers. The Design Consultant's primary responsibility is outside sales visits to customer homes and trade shows. Although sales efforts and incidental activities may take place at a customer's home or through virtual channels, a Design Consultant will spend the majority of his or her working time traveling and away from a dedicated office environment. Design Consultants will travel to customer\'s homes to make sales calls, assess customer needs, make individually-tailored product recommendations, develop and negotiate customized price quotes, present warranty information and financial options that meet the customer's needs and maintain/drive profitability. The Design Consultant will also complete required sales contracts and paperwork, and take measurements using industry standard methods to ensure orders meet required installation specifications. The Design Consultant is responsible for proactively soliciting and acquiring new customers inside assigned THD stores and during industry events (such as Home Shows). To drive sales and increase the pipeline of potential customers, a Design Consultant will travel to their assigned stores, maintain local relationships, educate store associates on HDIS offerings, and bring awareness to HDIS programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Travel and engage in outside sales activities, primarily in customers\' homes. Conduct professional and compelling sales presentations. Adapt quickly to changing customer needs and effectively advocate HDIS solutions.
  • Conduct incidental activities necessary to complete sales (e.g., assessing customer needs, develop price quotes, measure product specifications, etc.)
  • Present warranty and available financing options to customers. Prepare for appointments, commute to/from appointments and process sales-related paperwork.
  • Prospecting for new customers both inside and outside of assigned THD store and participate in scheduled industry events. Proactively seek out new referrals and develop and maintain relationships with store management and associates. Attend sales and store team meetings to continually improve sales techniques and learn about HDIS product offerings.

  • Requires regular and frequent local travel
  • Access to reliable transportation will be required
  • Reimbursement for travel will be available as required by state and federal law

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of prior in-home or virtual sales experience
  • Prior home improvement industry experience
  • Prior experience with successful lead generation
  • Computer and application skills and use of varied technology (email, iPad, apps, etc.)

Minimum Education

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Mid-Level Front-end Software Engineer to join our Marketplace Management Systems Team in Brazil ! This is a Remote position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

At the Marketplace Management Systems (MMS) team, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users, clients, and partners around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models.

We are responsible for the marketplace management systems, aimed to optimize the marketplace value for our users and partners while sustaining healthy margins for Wellhub. We look forward to developing sophisticated tools, pipelines, and predictive models to provide the best of the Wellhub partners to our users in an optimal setting. We develop services responsible for providing offers (Pricing), plans, restrictions of usage, etc, to be used by the entire ecosystem.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Develop, deliver, test, deploy, maintain and improve solutions working with a cross-functional team;
  • Write maintainable code and tests;
  • Take part in incident resolution and troubleshooting in the production environment, as well as in writing useful and critical post-mortems;
  • Support existing systems looking to enhance functionality, increase scale, and transform in new ways to meet our product demands;
  • Work in a collaborative and agile environment that prioritises people over process and is laser-focused on productivity;
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experienced in developing front-end based on RESTful APIs, collaborating with back-end teams to create mocks, define payloads, and follow best practices for HTTP;
  • Experience with the ReactJS ecosystem. However, candidates with knowledge of Angular or Vue are welcome;
  • Experience with automated, unit, and behavioural testing of react components;
  • Software quality and test automation mindset;
  • Experience with monitoring and observability front-end applications;
  • Experienced in applying computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithm design, problem-solving, and complexity analysis;
  • Communication skills to work with multidisciplinary teams located in several countries with different cultures;
  • Familiarity with NodeJS and the Backend For Front (BFF) pattern is nice to have;
  • Knowledge of SQL technologies such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, and understanding common use cases, is nice to have;
  • An engineer with intermediate or advanced proficiency in English;
  • Experience with React native will be a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

  • WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. description:
The Scrunch product involves acquiring and processing a lot of data, both using LLMs and more traditional analytics methods. In this role you will play a huge part in successfully delivering our roadmap and ultimately in giving our customers the tools they need to succeed in the AI era.

While most of your work will be focused on building features related to our data pipelines, usage of LLMs, analytics APIs, etc., you'll need to do whatever is necessary to deliver value to our customers. This can include some light React work but also work creating notifications, alert emails, scheduled reports, connectors into third party systems, etc.

For this role, we'd like to see candidates that:

    • Experience building API for external customers is a big plus.

    • Big data tools like Flink, Beam (GCP Dataflow), Spark, etc.

This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology - from the kernel through userspace. Apply here if you are an exceptional Go, Rust, or C/C++ software engineer and want to work on next-generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage.
Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.
Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.
RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.
Docker images are easy to make and publish on Docker Hub and other registries, but the quality, consistency and security maintenance of those images is broadly very poor. Canonical is in a good position to publish a portfolio of outstanding Docker images. Our Rockcraft team is designing and implementing an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
LXD is a modern system container and virtual machine manager that is widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI.
Members of the Kubernetes product team build MicroK8s for on-rails K8s, and Charmed Kubernetes for more sophisticated integration. We work on K8s itself and on the operations tooling around it.
The OpenStack team deliver Charmed OpenStack, OVN / OVS and Ceph. This work brings cloud platform technologies to large-scale computing environments.
These teams hire system level C/C++, Golang, Rust and Python developers to work on security-critical, performance-critical and mission-critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management. Our teams are motivated to have a meaningful impact on modern cloud computing technologies.
